entities.name: Stanisław Łubieński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Łubieński, of Pomian coat of arms, was a Polish noble, politician and bishop. Royal Secretary of king Sigismund III of Poland from 1591; regent of Royal Chancellery from 1614, Crown Secretary, bishop of Łuck from 1622, Deputy Chancellor of the Crown from 1626 and bishop of Płock from 1627.
